metric: SPES's Calcite pairs whose SQL differs from SQLSolver's wording of the same test: 29 proved equivalent, and all 3 pairs whose SPES text is not equivalent refuted with a DuckDB counterexample.
caveats: SPES ships the same 232 Calcite tests as SQLSolver; 137 are textually SQLSolver's pairs and are not re-scored. Of the other 95, 61 cannot run (mostly SPES's own SQL bugs and empty VALUES) and are counted unsupported. testSemiJoinRule, testSemiJoinRuleExists and testSemiJoinTrim are relabelled not equivalent: SPES's text joins EMP rows that are not de-duplicated (see tests/fixtures/spes/README.md).
correctness: 0 false proofs (re-checked on 120 random DuckDB databases, half skewed towards the literals)
